session_summary: Bug-fix session targeting the four F63/F64/F65 admin tab issues found during browser-test preparation. No new features built.

bugs_fixed.title: Duplicate GET /api/admin/users handler — role filter unreachable
bugs_fixed.notes: Second handler at line 2432 was shadowed by the first at line 2011. Merged ?role filter into single handler. When role param present: returns { users: [...] } shape. Without it: returns legacy plain array. Dead handler deleted.

bugs_fixed.title: Admin tab components sending wrong auth header
bugs_fixed.notes: All three tabs sent Authorization: Bearer <jwt> but server requireAdmin() checks x-backend-api-key. Fixed to use VITE_BACKEND_API_KEY via x-backend-api-key header.

bugs_fixed.title: Orgs response shape mismatch in admin tabs
bugs_fixed.notes: /api/admin/organizations returns a plain array, not { organizations: [] }. Tabs called .organizations on it, always getting undefined → []. Added Array.isArray() guard.

bugs_fixed.title: GET /api/leagues blocking admin callers (no x-user-id)
bugs_fixed.notes: AdminLeaguesTab has no user context, so it couldn't pass x-user-id. Added: if valid x-backend-api-key present, bypass user-id check. Admins also see inactive leagues; users see active-only.
